title: Co-founded Mindray in Shenzhen in 1991 with Xu Hang and Cheng Minghe
statement: Co-founded Mindray in Shenzhen in 1991 with Xu Hang and Cheng Minghe, focused on domestic patient-monitoring, imaging, and diagnostic products.

title: Listed Mindray on the NYSE in 2006
statement: Listed Mindray on the NYSE in 2006, then took it private in a 2016 buyout led by Li and the other two co-founders, followed by a re-listing on China's A-share market.
outcome: Mindray successfully transitioned from a NYSE-listed company (delisted March 2016 per the buyout) to relisting on China's domestic A-share market (Shenzhen Stock Exchange, ticker 300760), and grew into a company reporting US$5.1 billion in 2024 revenue.
